intro: You are standing on Alacahöyük, a mound in Çorum province whose story reaches back to the 4th millennium BC. It is one of Anatolia's first excavation sites, known for its sphinx gate and its Hattian royal tombs.
history: This mound holds a special place in the history of Turkish archaeology: it was among the first excavations of the Turkish Republic. From its royal tombs came the sun discs that became a symbol of Anatolian civilisation.
structure-1: You are now before the Sphinx Gate. Look at the sphinx reliefs flanking this monumental gate, still keeping watch over the entrance.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the Hattian royal tombs and the Hittite temple, and take a close look at the Orthostat reliefs.
facts: Did you know? The sun disc found here served for decades as the emblem of Ankara. The bronze 'sun discs' from its royal tombs became the most reproduced archaeological emblem in modern Türkiye. The reliefs flanking the Sphinx Gate show a Hittite religious ceremony step by step. And excavation began in 1935 on Atatürk's instruction, among the first major digs the young Republic ran with its own resources.
outro: This brings our tour of Alacahöyük to an end. Please leave the stones untouched, keep to the marked paths and carry water with you. These stones have waited for centuries; let them wait for those who come after you. Enjoy your visit.
